name: Alcaldía de Medellín
body: nosniff, framing limited to its origin, a canonical, a clear description, and two sitemaps named in robots.txt. But none of the 19 pages analyzed sends Strict-Transport-Security, so a first http visit can be intercepted.
lesson: Send HSTS with a one-year max-age once every subdomain serves https.
summary: www.medellin.gov.co scores 74 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 28 are at risk, and 17 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 16 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 58 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /es/, /es/nuestro-alcalde/, /es/despacho-de-la-primera-dama/, /es/dagrd/ and 12 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Analytics may count some visits twice
fix.evidence: 16 pages load gtag.js more than once.
fix.fix: Keep one GA4 property per site and load gtag.js once, or manage it only inside Tag Manager.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 16 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: The sitemap lists 3 pages search engines should not index
fix.evidence: /es (Only https URLs can be reviewed.), /es/secretaria-de-educacion/ (The page took too long.), /es/secretaria-gestion-y-control-territorial/ (The page took too long.).
fix.fix: List only live, canonical, indexable URLs in the sitemap.

fix.title: Universal Analytics code is still on the page
fix.evidence: Google stopped processing Universal Analytics data in July 2024. The code adds weight and collects nothing.
fix.fix: Remove the UA- tag and keep GA4.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 172 ms
Every page has a meta description
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
